title: How Many Live Snowsports School Bookings One Household Account May Carry
content:
A household account carries a separate Snowsports School booking for every participant and every start date, so a family putting two children into a morning group and a parent into a private lesson holds three bookings, not one.

## 1. The limit and what counts against it

The account may carry several live bookings at once up to the number this charter allows, which is 8. Bookings in the asked-for, waiting, firm and under-way states count against that number; bookings that have reached the delivered, cancelled, missed or closed states no longer count. A further booking is refused once the account is already at that number, and the household is asked to let a live booking run through before adding another.

## 2. Two bookings that are the same booking

Two bookings of the same product for the same participant on the same first session date are never opened; the second is treated as a duplicate of the first and the household is asked whether they meant a different date or a different participant.

The judgement is made on the collective's own booking records before the booking is opened, not on what the household says it has booked. Three things are matched: the household account, the participant's name as the household states it on the booking, and the date the first session is due to run. Only bookings standing in the asked-for, waiting, firm or under-way states are matched. Where those three agree, the product booked and the mountain are what tell one booking from another.

## 3. Points of judgement

| Existing live booking | Booking now asked for | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson for one child on a given date | the same product, the same child, the same date | the second is a duplicate of the first |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson for one child on a given date | the same product, the same child, the next day | not a duplicate: the first session dates differ |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson for one child on a given date | the same product, a sibling, the same date | not a duplicate: the participants differ |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson for one child on a given date, already cancelled | the same product, the same child, the same date | the cancelled booking is not matched, so the new booking is not a duplicate |

A household account already carrying 8 live bookings is at the number this charter allows, so a ninth is refused; an account carrying 7 live bookings is below it, and an eighth is taken.
